description: Unit tests for JniEnvExt class, testing string conversion methods between UTF-8, UTF-16, and modified UTF-8 in an Android JNI environment.

classes.name: JniEnvExt
classes.description: JNI environment extension class providing string conversion methods.

methods.name: NewStringStandardUTFOrAbort
methods.description: Creates a Java string from a UTF-8 string, aborts on failure.

methods.name: GetStringChars
methods.description: Retrieves the Unicode characters from a Java string.

methods.name: GetStringLength
methods.description: Returns the length of a Java string in characters.

methods.name: ReleaseStringChars
methods.description: Releases the buffer obtained from GetStringChars.

methods.name: NewStringUTF
methods.description: Creates a Java string from a modified UTF-8 string.

methods.name: NewString
methods.description: Creates a Java string from a UTF-16 string.

methods.name: GetStringStandardUTFOrAbort
methods.description: Converts a Java string to a standard UTF-8 std::string, aborts on failure.
